name: Department Code Null Check
sql:
SELECT *
FROM siebel.cx_jrnl_vchr
WHERE created >= SYSDATE - 1
  AND (x_d_dep_cd IS NULL OR x_c_dep_cd IS NULL)

name: Duplicate Recycle Order Check
sql:
SELECT 
    root_order_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM siebel.s_order
WHERE order_type_id in ('1-7N9K')
  AND root_order_id NOT IN (
        '1-26ONSU_D', '1-U5A-1', '2-SCJ-7', '2-SCJ-8', 
        '2-SCJ-9', '2-SCJ-14', '2-SCJ-16', '2-SCJ-20', 
        '2-SCJ-21', '2-SCJ-22'
      )
GROUP BY root_order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

name: Department Code Mismatch Check
sql:
SELECT 
    A.ORDER_NUM,
    D.LOGIN       AS created_by,
    G.LOGIN       AS posted_by,
    H.X_D_DEP_CD  AS dep_in_jv,
    I.LOC         AS poster_dep_cd,
    C.LOC         AS creator_dep
FROM SIEBEL.S_ORDER        A
JOIN SIEBEL.S_CONTACT      B ON A.CREATED_BY = B.ROW_ID
JOIN SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT      C ON B.BU_ID = C.PAR_ROW_ID
JOIN SIEBEL.S_USER         D ON A.CREATED_BY = D.ROW_ID
JOIN SIEBEL.S_POSTN        F ON A.PR_POSTN_ID = F.PAR_ROW_ID
JOIN SIEBEL.S_USER         G ON F.PR_EMP_ID = G.ROW_ID
JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT X_D_PROJ_CD, X_D_DEP_CD
        FROM SIEBEL.CX_JRNL_VCHR
        WHERE X_D_PROJ_CD LIKE 'A%' 
          AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%Sales%' 
          AND CREATED >= SYSDATE - 1
     ) H ON A.ORDER_NUM = H.X_D_PROJ_CD
JOIN SIEBEL.S_ORG_EXT      I ON A.BU_ID = I.PAR_ROW_ID
WHERE A.ORDER_NUM IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT X_D_PROJ_CD
        FROM SIEBEL.CX_JRNL_VCHR
        WHERE X_D_PROJ_CD LIKE 'A%'
          AND CREATED >= SYSDATE - 1
     ) AND H.X_D_DEP_CD <> I.LOC

name: Chassis & Body Order Account Code Mismatch Check

SELECT ROW_ID, CREATED, X_ORDER_TYPE, X_D_SEG1_CD, X_D_AC_ITM_CD, X_D_SUB_ACITM_CD, X_C_AC_ITM_CD, X_C_SUB_ACITM_CD
FROM SIEBEL.CX_JRNL_VCHR
WHERE (x_d_ac_itm_cd = '038' OR x_c_ac_itm_cd = '038')
  AND (X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%Chassis%' or X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%Body Building%')
  AND created >= SYSDATE - 1
recovery_template:
UPDATE SIEBEL.CX_JRNL_VCHR 
SET X_D_AC_ITM_CD = CASE 
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'LDB' THEN '031'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'MDB' THEN '031'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDB' THEN '031'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = '1.5t' THEN '030'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'LDT' THEN '030'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'MDT' THEN '030'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDT' THEN '030'
        ELSE X_D_AC_ITM_CD
        END,

        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'LDB' THEN '60'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'MDB' THEN '50'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDB' THEN '40'

        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDT' THEN '10'
        ELSE X_D_SUB_ACITM_CD
        END,
    X_C_AC_ITM_CD = CASE 
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'LDB' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '031'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'MDB' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '031'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDB' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '031'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = '1.5t' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '030'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'LDT' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '030'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'MDT' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '030'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDT' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '030'
        ELSE X_C_AC_ITM_CD
        END,
    X_C_SUB_ACITM_CD = CASE 
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'LDB' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '60'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'MDB' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '50'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDB' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '40'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = '1.5t' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '37'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'LDT' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '30'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'MDT' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '20'
        WHEN X_C_SEG1_CD = 'HDT' AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE '%MAP%' THEN '10'
        ELSE X_C_SUB_ACITM_CD
        END
WHERE ROW_ID IN ('1-2WJYXB');

name: Data Set Separator Issue
sql:
WITH DistinctAbstracts AS (
    SELECT 
        x_voucher_abstract, 
        X_ABSTRACT, 
        CREATED
    FROM SIEBEL.CX_JRNL_VCHR
    WHERE X_D_PROJ_CD LIKE 'PT%'
      AND X_ORDER_TYPE LIKE 'Parts Sales%'
      AND CREATED >= SYSDATE - 1
),

SameCreatedPairs AS (
    SELECT da1.x_voucher_abstract
    FROM DistinctAbstracts da1
    JOIN DistinctAbstracts da2
      ON da1.x_voucher_abstract = da2.x_voucher_abstract
     AND da1.X_ABSTRACT <> da2.X_ABSTRACT
     AND da1.CREATED = da2.CREATED
    GROUP BY da1.x_voucher_abstract
)

SELECT 
    scp.x_voucher_abstract,
    COUNT(DISTINCT da.X_ABSTRACT) AS distinct_abstract_count
FROM SameCreatedPairs scp
JOIN DistinctAbstracts da 
  ON scp.x_voucher_abstract = da.x_voucher_abstract
GROUP BY scp.x_voucher_abstract
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT da.X_ABSTRACT) >= 2

name: Com Inbox Daily Recovery
sql:
select
c.name "Name",
d.login,
b.name "Type",
a.status_cd,
e.status,
a.row_id,
a.created,
a.last_upd,
a.active_flg,
e.last_upd
from
siebel.S_UNVBX_ITMTASK a,
siebel.S_UNVBX_ITMTYPE b,
siebel.S_UNVBX_ITEM c,
siebel.S_USER d,
siebel.CX_apr_hst_xm e
where
c.UNVBX_ITMTYPE_ID = b.row_id(+)
and a.UNVBX_ITEM_ID = c.row_id(+)
and a.APPROVER_ID = d.row_id(+)
and a.unvbx_item_id = e.INBOXITEM_ID(+)
and b.type_cd = 'Approvals'
and e.status <> 'Pending for Approval'
and a.active_flg = 'Y'
--and c.name in ('1-4NERWAR','1-4IVCWF6')
order by a.last_upd desc
recovery_template: update SIEBEL.s_unvbx_itmtask set active_flg = 'N',db_last_upd = sysdate where row_id in ('','');

name: PO to WH
sql:
select T1.ROW_ID, T1.SHIP_NUM, T2.ORDER_NUM, T4.X_PRINT_STATUS , t1.CREATED
from siebel.S_SHIPMENT T1, siebel.S_ORDER T2, siebel.S_INVLOC T3, siebel.CX_SHIPMENT_X T4
where T1.PR_ORDER_ID = T2.ROW_ID and T2.X_INVENTORY_ID = T3.ROW_ID 
and T3.X_SHOP_CODE in ('10TW','10UW') and T2.X_PARTS_PO_REF = 'PO To WH'
and T1.ROW_ID = T4.PAR_ROW_ID
and T4.X_PRINT_STATUS LIKE 'Error%'
and T1.CREATED>=SYSDATE -1

name: Duplicate Pool Cost Order Check
sql:

    root_order_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM siebel.s_order
WHERE order_type_id in ('1-7N8X')
GROUP BY root_order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

name: Duplicate Planned Pool Cost-Procurement Order Check
sql:

    root_order_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM siebel.s_order
WHERE order_type_id in ('1-7N9Q')
AND ROOT_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL 
AND (ROOT_ORDER_ID NOT IN ('DUMMY-2-7AC3VK', '2-8346-1_dummy', 'DUMMY-2-7BAYGM', 'DUMMY-1-2BNSE3', 'DUMMY-1-3QV3-2'))

HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
